featured_reviews.name: Brionie Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely love the touch of whimsy and color The Druid’s Garden has brought to my home. Main recommend karta hoon!

name: Janata Stationery & Art Bandra
description:
Established in 1970, Janata Book Centre was started by Late.Khimji Lalji Chheda which specialized in
school and college books along with school and office stationery.
Later in 1988 Mr.Ashok Khimji Chheda s/o Khimji Lalji Chheda joined the family business and introduced
a range of fine art and craft materials.
As the demand for fine art materials increased, slowly we started to focus on the fine art range.
Now we specialise in Fine Art, Architectural, Interior, Jewellery, Fashion Designing Materials, School & Office Stationery. Now the store is also known as “Janata Stationery & Art"
Soon Mr. Chheda inaugurated another store for All types of Papers & Craft Materials known as "Veerat Paper Bazar"

Three months ago my wife and I wandered into this beautiful shop in Bandra, and we immediately fell in love with the craftsmanship and the pieces they curate for the home. The items are truly magnificent—each one feels thoughtful, unique, and made to elevate a space.

There was one particular piece my wife absolutely loved, and I decided it would be the perfect gift for her birthday. Unfortunately it wasn’t in stock at the time—but they went out of their way to source it before my wife’s birthday.

What happened next was even more impressive. Knowing I was tied up at work, they personally arranged delivery to our home to make sure it arrived in time for the celebration.

From craftsmanship to customer service, this was one of the most remarkable retail experiences I’ve ever had. Truly exceptional.

featured_reviews.name: Sheldon Dias
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the St. Pauls Media Complex, St Paul Book And Art Centre Mumbai is a serene landmark that serves as a one-stop destination for spiritual literature and religious artifacts. It is particularly well-regarded for its peaceful, library-like atmosphere, offering a quiet refuge for visitors to browse through a wide range of specialized materials.
• Diverse Collection: The store is a major hub for religious and spiritual books, including Bibles in various editions, theological texts, and Catholic literature, as well as academic titles, CBSE textbooks, and children's storybooks.
• Art and Gifts: Beyond literature, it features an extensive selection of religious artifacts, such as statues, rosaries, candles, and framed prints, making it a popular spot for meaningful gifts and church supplies.
• Holiday Highlights: During the Christmas season, the first floor transforms into a festive destination stocked with unique décor, souvenirs, and seasonal ornaments.
• Supportive Environment: Visitors frequently mention the well-organized layout and the helpful, professional staff who are knowledgeable about the inventory and assist with niche title requests.

Since I am here, should also mention that our purchases with Art of Time started with Farooq, who is an absolute gem. We bought our first watch from Art of Time in February 2021, and have been in touch with Art of Time because of Farooq!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Contacted Shamim Shaikh for Jaeger Le Couture and Cartier Watch but she have no value for clients time making wait for offer for indefinite time, strange how such time keeper and seller of such high value brands have such sales representatives with art of no time value for clients.

Good luck, we shall choose buying in our home Dubai Boutiques.

featured_reviews.name: Eesha Priya
featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome watch buying experience. Sales people very educated and not too pushy. You can try various watches and not buy anything.

featured_reviews.name: Kushal Ramotre
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kudos to Juhi + team at Jio World Complex for making our experience/purchase really memorable - we were actually on the fence, but were convinced by the crew (without being pushy). Great set of people!

Since I am here, should also mention that our purchases with Art of Time started with Farooq, who is an absolute gem. We bought our first watch from Art of Time in February 2021, and have been in touch with Art of Time because of Farooq!

Dealing with the lovely people at Art of Time really makes our experience worthwhile - which cannot be said of all retailers in the country!

featured_reviews.name: Porus V
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience purchasing a watch from Art of Time. The staff is extremely helpful, friendly and professional. The entire process was seamless. We knew which watch we wanted, but they also have a wide selection of watches and brands to choose from.

featured_reviews.name: KMS
featured_reviews.review_text: Shopping with Juhi at Jio World was a seamless experience. Excellent customer service. Thank you.
